title: A sign-changing Poisson kernel for a non-symmetric elliptic operator in a bounded domain
summary: We construct an explicit sign-changing Poisson kernel for a uniformly elliptic divergence form operator in the unit disk. The coefficient matrix is non-symmetric, and its skew-symmetric part has a jump discontinuity across a fixed diameter, with the size of the jump determined by $k\in\mathbb R$. For each $1<p<\infty$, the associated $L^p$ Dirichlet problem undergoes a sharp transition as $k$ crosses a $p$-dependent threshold.
